name: OpusClip
price: Free; Starter US$15/mo; Pro US$29/mo; Business custom
watermark: Watermarked on free exports; watermark-free export requires Starter or above
bestFor: Turning long videos or podcasts into short vertical clips with captions, without manual editing
notFor: Frame-accurate manual editing, offline work, or projects that are not clip-based
limits: Free: regular processing speed, local uploads up to 10GB per video, and animated captions carry a watermark. Watermark-free export and export to Premiere/DaVinci are paid. The monthly processing allowance is not stated on the public pricing page.
